mapper.select: SELECT id, employee_no, name, phone, department_id, position_id, status, hire_date, leave_date FROM employee WHERE employee_no = #{employeeNo} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employee (employee_no, name, phone, department_id, position_id, status, hire_date) VALUES (#{employeeNo}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{departmentId}, #{positionId}, #{status}, #{hireDate})
mapper.update: UPDATE employee SET department_id = COALESCE(#{departmentId}, department_id), position_id = COALESCE(#{positionId}, position_id), status = #{status}, hire_date = COALESCE(#{hireDate}, hire_date), leave_date = #{leaveDate} WHERE id = #{id}
